game_title: Program Assembler – Buried Temple Steps Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the program_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the camel pen using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The camel pen reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the camel pen is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Program Assembler
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
